field: Name: the display name that other players see everywhere
basis: OWASP Input Validation Cheat Sheet: accept only an allowlist and apply one normalization rule
RFC 8265 (PRECIS usernames): no spaces inside an identifier; compare names without case
lengthUnit: Unicode code points after NFC normalization
uniqueness: Backend only: two names are the same when their lowercase forms are equal.

checks.rule: Fails when the name is empty.
Fails when the name contains any whitespace character, including at the start or end.
checks.message: Do not use spaces in your name.

checks.rule: Fails when the normalized name has fewer than minLength or more than maxLength characters.
Fails when the normalized name does not match pattern: English letters, numbers, and _ only, starting with a letter.
checks.message: Use only English letters, numbers, and _. Start with a letter.

checks.rule: Fails when the lowercase name equals a reserved word.
checks.message: This name is reserved. Choose another one.

result: Run the checks in order and stop at the first failure. The result is accepted with no reason, or not accepted with the id of the failed check.
